label: Agent proposal 1
hypothesis: Enabling entity filtering and time-aware retrieval will select the requested subject and validity interval before ranking, correcting entity distractor and historical/future-date failures without changing writes or hard-constraint behavior.
predicted_effect: Task success should improve on entity-grounding, distractor-retrieval, historical-address, future-move, and related temporal cases; retrieval should contain fewer irrelevant records and reduce stale-fact errors.
